title: Studies on lateralization and aggression in Nile tilapia using mirror, dyadic and predator inspection tests
desc: Eye-use and aggressive display in Oreochromis niloticus across three behavioural assays — my undergraduate line, and the first place I measured animals from footage rather than by eye.
authors: Ariyomo, T. O., __Olatoye, D. S.__ & Jegede, T.
